I am an economist working as a consultant at the **World Bank** in Washington, DC.
I received my Ph.D. in Economics from the **University of Houston** in 2023.

My research interests are macroeconomics, development economics, and public economics.
I study household economic decisions concerning consumption, saving, fertility, and
human capital formation using calibrated life-cycle/OLG models and econometric methods.
At the World Bank, I work on labor markets, long-term growth, inequality, and
middle-class formation in developing economies.

**Research fields:** Macroeconomics · Development Economics · Public Economics
